group: Round 7 · Gear on the heroes: weapons in hand, armour worn
title: Weapons in hand 2: the legendaries
use: Fixes the look of the legendary and boss-signature weapon models (game/js/entities/gear/weapons.js).
prompt: A model sheet of blocky 3D voxel weapons, each a separate held model laid out in rows on a flat light-grey background at one shared scale (a hero's fist is one block), seen from the high three-quarter game angle with the grip at the bottom left and the point or head at the top right, as a hero holds it; each weapon readable at small size by its silhouette, with a small second view of its most distinctive part beside it. In this order: 1. Backbiter, a sword whose blade is half celestial bronze and half grey steel, split lengthwise, with a dark spiked crossguard; 2. Stygian Iron Blade, a black sword with a violet glowing edge that drinks the light; 3. Twin Huntress Knives, a pair of curved silver moon-knives; 4. Imperial Gold Gladius, a short Roman sword of shining gold with an eagle-head pommel; 5. Harpe of Perseus, a silver sword with a sickle hook curving off its spine; 6. Club of Heracles, a huge knotty olive-wood club studded with bronze, held in both hands; 7. Pelian Spear of Achilles, a long spear banded in gold with a blue pennant; 8. Burning Sword of Ares, a broad black blade with a red-hot core and flames along its edges; 9. Axe of Boreas, a two-handed ice-blue axe with frost crystals growing from it; 10. Spear of the Storm, a silver spear head wrapped in forked white lightning; 11. Tide-Forged Sword, a sea-green bronze blade with a wave-shaped crossguard and a trident pommel; 12. Fury's Flaming Lash, a leather handle and a coil of fire held out like a whip; 13. Horn of the Minotaur, a great curved bull's horn held by its leather-bound root; 14. Chimera Fang Spear, a spear tipped with a poison-green glowing fang, a lion's mane tassel and a snake tail wound down the shaft; 15. Procrustes's Cleaver, a butcher's cleaver the size of a door with a measuring rule along it, held in both hands. 3D game art in the blocky voxel style of Minecraft Dungeons: characters built from cubes, with a large cube head whose face is simple pixel art (about 8 × 8 pixels: pixel eyes, a pixel mouth, hair drawn as pixels and as a few blocky tufts), a boxy torso, square arms and legs, crisp pixel-art textures (about 16 pixels per block) with simple shading, chunky readable silhouettes; warm cinematic lighting, soft ambient occlusion and glowing magic effects. Costume colours and details follow the Camp Half-Blood cartoon concept art. Palette: camp orange #f28c28, sea teal #0f6f73, deep navy #10233d, jade #2e8b6e, coral #e8664a, bronze gold #c9963a, lightning yellow #ffd84a, parchment cream #f4ead5, vase black #17130f and owl grey #8c96a3. No lettering, logos, captions or watermark.
